summary: After upgrading automation dashboard, copy clusters.yaml into the automation-dashboard-web container and run manage.py setclusters; verify with manage.py getclusters --decrypt that access_token, refresh_token, client_id and client_secret appear.
questions: How do I apply clusters.yaml to automation dashboard?
How do I check the automation dashboard cluster configuration?

answer_card.title: Load clusters.yaml into automation dashboard
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
podman cp clusters.yaml automation-dashboard-web:/tmp/
podman exec -it automation-dashboard-web /venv/bin/python manage.py setclusters /tmp/clusters.yaml
# verify
podman exec -it automation-dashboard-web /venv/bin/python ./manage.py getclusters --decrypt
```
The output should show `access_token`, `refresh_token`, `client_id` and `client_secret`.
